description:
A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na orientação técnica da equipe, explanando sobre os padrões de qualidade preestabelecidos, acompanhando as tarefas executadas pelos profissionais em período de treinamento e efetuando a correção das ações realizadas de maneira inadequada, atuando como referência da área na ausência do superior imediato;

title: Mineral Strategy Analyst - Aramco Transition Minerals -  (Based in Saudi Arabia - expat relocat[...]
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent, expat position.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Transition Minerals Strategy Analyst to join Aramco Transition Minerals organization to lead our efforts in securing, managing, and optimizing the sustainable use of transition minerals critical to the global energy transition. These minerals, such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earth elements, are essential for renewable energy technologies, and other clean energy solutions. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in strategic planning, supply chain management, ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles, and policy advocacy. This role will also involve collaboration across industries, governments, and communities to address challenges and opportunities in the evolving transition minerals landscape.

About Aramco Transition Minerals (ATM)

Aramco Transition Minerals (ATM) is a new strategic initiative within Saudi Aramco’s Upstream division, created to advance the exploration, extraction, and processing of key energy transition minerals—including lithium—to support the global shift toward sustainable energy solutions and contribute to the Kingdom’s economic diversification goals.

Anchored in the ambitions of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030, ATM is positioned to help establish the Kingdom as a leading global hub for critical minerals. The organization focuses on high‑value resources such as lithium, silicon, copper, nickel, graphite, and rare earth elements—materials essential to technologies like electric vehicles, renewable energy storage systems, and solar power generation.

As a newly formed and rapidly growing entity, ATM represents a significant opportunity to shape an emerging sector, drive technological innovation, and support the development of a resilient, future‑focused minerals supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Lead the development of a comprehensive, long-term strategy for sourcing and utilizing transition minerals. This strategy should align with our organizational goals in sustainability, innovation, and growth.
  • Monitor and interpret global trends, including technological advancements, regulatory changes, and market dynamics, to identify opportunities and risks for the organization.
  • Establish a roadmap for securing critical mineral resources while prioritizing long‑term sustainability and resilience.
  • Provide insights and recommendations on mineral financing strategies, investment opportunities, and risk management.
  • Collaborate with procurement and legal teams to establish long‑term agreements with suppliers who meet sustainability criteria.
  • Act as a liaison between the company and key external stakeholders, including government agencies, potential investors and industry groups
  • Represent the company at international conferences, working groups, and forums focused on transition minerals, ensuring our leadership and reputation in the industry.
  • Develop and review financial models, feasibility studies, and cost‑benefit analyses for mining and mineral projects.
  • Lead or support the evaluation, negotiation, and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and industry best practices
  • Develop mitigation strategies to address risks such as resource scarcity, geopolitical tensions, and supply disruptions.
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and trends that could redefine the transition minerals landscape.
  • Track and report on global mineral production, consumption patterns, and pricing trends to inform decision‑making.
  • Continuously monitor and analyze industry data, reports, and market trends to provide actionable insights to the leadership team.
  • Develop comprehensive reports and presentations for executive leadership, detailing progress, risks, and recommendations.

As a successful candidate you hold a:

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Mining Geology, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in energy transition minerals (lithium, cobalt, nickel, or rare earth elements) development with a focus in strategy.
  • The ability to work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, to communicate effectively and clearly with specialists in other cross‑functional teams, and has excellent problem‑solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Expertise in critical minerals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earth elements, including their applications, extraction methods, and market dynamics
  • Strong understanding of mineralogy and metallurgical principles for transition minerals.
  • Knowledge of circular economy principles and recycling of transition minerals.
  • The ability to develop the business case strategically.
  • The ability to relocate to Saudi Arabia on a full‑time basis.
  • Advanced English proficiency. CV's must be submitted in English.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Cloud Engineer (GCP)
description:
At Paymentology , we’re redefining what’s possible in the payments space. As the first truly global issuer-processor, we give banks and fintechs the technology and talent to launch and manage Mastercard and Visa cards at scale - across more than 60 countries.

Our advanced, multi-cloud platform delivers real-time data, unmatched scalability, and the flexibility of shared or dedicated processing instances. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer (GCP) to design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure powering our global payments platform. As a senior technical specialist, you will own cloud architecture decisions across Google Cloud Platform, contribute to multi-cloud implementations, and ensure our infrastructure meets strict performance, security, and regulatory requirements.

If you're an expert in GCP, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code, and thrive in complex, high-availability environments, this is your opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure in a truly global fintech environment.

What you get to do

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure cloud architectures on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Define, implement, and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform to ensure repeatable and reliable deployments.
  • Architect, build, and support multi-cloud environments aligned with business and platform strategy.
  • Implement and maintain cloud security controls aligned with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and other regulatory standards.
  • Maintain cloud migration initiatives from on-premises environments to GCP, ensuring minimal disruption and optimal performance.
  • Continuously optimize cloud environments for cost efficiency, scalability, observability, and resilience.

Optional

  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes (GKE) clusters and Kafka platforms to support distributed, high-throughput systems.

Requirements

What it takes to succeed

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cloud engineering or infrastructure engineering roles.
  • Deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform and cloud-native architecture principles.
  • Advanced knowledge of Terraform and modern DevOps tooling for Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD automation.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, performance tuning, and cloud security best practices.
  • Experience operating in regulated, high-availability, or payments environments.
  • Ability to operate autonomously as a trusted technical owner, solving complex, multi-system challenges and influencing cloud standards across teams.
  • Strong understanding of GCP global architecture including Regions, Zones, and Global VPC design.
  • Strong IAM expertise covering roles, service accounts, and least privilege implementation.
  • Ability to design scalable VPC architectures including hub-and-spoke and Shared VPC models.
  • Good networking fundamentals including subnets, routing, and GCP firewall rule configuration.
  • Good to have experience with APIGEE/API gateway.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (GKE) and Kafka in production environments.

What you can look forward to

At Paymentology , it’s not just about building great payment technology, it’s about building a company where people feel they belong and their work matters. You’ll be part of a diverse, global team that’s genuinely committed to making a positive impact through what we do. Whether you’re working across time zones or getting involved in initiatives that support local communities, you’ll find real purpose in your work - and the freedom to grow in a supportive, forward-thinking environment.

title: Senior Manager, Special Events FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world‑class event experiences that elevate the tournament’s global impact.

Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ special events. The role ensures seamless, high‑quality delivery aligned with FIFA’s brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.

Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament’s international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast‑paced, and multicultural environment.

Key responsibilities

1, Strategic Event Planning & Delivery

Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of major tournament‑related events, including but not limited to:

  • Oficial Dinner
  • Final Draw
  • Brand Launch
  • Mascot Launch
  • Team Workshop
  • Volunteers Kick‑Off Event
  • Guest activities, when required
  • Coordination of Legends Matches
  • Participation in pre‑match ceremonies
  • Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA’s global positioning.

2. Creative Direction & Experience Design

  • Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.
  • Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
  • Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup™.

3. Operational & Logistical Oversight

  • Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.
  • Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.
  • Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.

4. Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.
  • Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.
  • Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.

5. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.
  • Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.
  • Manage protocol requirements and high‑profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.

6. Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.
  • Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
  • Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.

Your profile

Education

  • A Master’s degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Additional executive education in large-scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
  • Proven experience leading high‑profile, broadcast‑level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government‑level functions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi‑million‑dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
  • Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega‑events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.

Skills & Competencie

Strategic & Operational Excellence

  • Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
  • Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
  • Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong decision‑making skills under pressure.

Financial & Commercial Acumen

  • Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost‑control expertise.
  • Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.

Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage high‑level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and solutions‑driven.
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
  • High integrity and alignment with FIFA’s values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.

Requiriments

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

About the Job

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing the preparation and negotiation of a diverse range of commercial agreements in support of Tether's various business lines. Your role will support business lines spanning stablecoins, artificial intelligence, peer-to-peer communications applications, education, power and human evolution by helping implement clear, legally sound commercial agreements. Agreements will vary by business line but will generally include master services agreements, software-as-a-services agreements, non-disclosure agreements, sponsorship agreements, collaboration agreements, and memorandums of understanding.

Your role will also involve overseeing direct reports who work on negotiating commercial agreements and acting as an escalation point both for those direct reports and for the various business line clients.

Responsibilities

  • Managing and overseeing direct reports working on negotiating commercial agreements
  • Acting as an escalation point for direct reports and business line clients

  • Identifying and mitigating or escalating legal risks
  • Acting as a liaison between various stakeholder groups and the business line in connection with shaping and preparing commercial agreements

Qualifications

  • A Bachelor's degree in law
  • 5 years of experience in a contract negotiation or manager position
  • A strong command of English
  • Proficiency with workflow management tools like Monday.com and Jotform
  • A strong attention to detail

Bonus points if:

  • Qualified to practice law
  • 2 years of people management
  • Experience with crypto assets

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

COMO SERÁ O SEU DIA A DIA:

  • Supervisionar a operação e manutenção dos sistemas de utilidades: compressores de ar e secadores; caldeiras ; sistemas de água (captação/abastecimento, tratamento e distribuição); rede de gás natural; aquecedor e circuito de óleo térmico; sistemas de vapor nas dependências fabris;
  • Planejar e aprovar PMOC/planos de manutenção, backlog e sobressalentes críticos; coordenar inspeções legais (NR-13/vasos de pressão/caldeiras), testes de segurança e calibrações de instrumentação;

  • Investigar, tratar e liderar análises de causas (RCA), processos para gestão de mudanças (GMUD) e planos de contingência para indisponibilidade de utilidades.

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Formação em Engenharia (Mecânica, Química, Elétrica ou Automação) ou Tecnólogo com sólida experiência em utilidades industriais;
  • Experiência em operação/manutenção de sistemas de utilidades: compressores, secadores de ar, caldeiras, queimadores, redes de gás natural e sistemas de óleo térmico;
  • Conhecimento em NR-13, NR-10, NR-12, NR-20 e legislações ambientais (INEA/CONAMA);
  • Leitura de P&ID, instrumentação e noções de automação (CLP/SDCD, intertravamentos);
  • Vivência com gestão de contratos, CAPEX, KPIs de manutenção e eficiência energética.

Sua energia se destaca mais se você tiver estes itens:

  • Certificação NR-13 (responsável por vasos/caldeiras) e conhecimento em ISO 50001;
  • Experiência nos setores de óleo e gás, químico, alimentos/bebidas ou lubrificantes;
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão (ISO 14001/9001, SSMA) e metodologias Lean, TPM, RCA, RCM e técnicas preditivas (análise vibracional, termografia, ultrassom).

Informações adicionais

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVO:

Nosso processo contempla 3 etapas principais (podem ter outras, e você ficará por dentro caso avance):

  1. Inscrição - preenchimento deste formulário e de dados adicionais, caso necessário.
  2. Entrevista com o RH - um bate-papo para nos conhecermos.
  3. Entrevista com a liderança: bate-papo mais técnico para contar ainda mais sobre o dia a dia e os desafios.

Nossa comunicação será por e-mail e telefone - confira se seus dados estão atualizados.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
F&B Concessions Coordinator

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision-making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow-up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow-up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre-tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large-scale international events, preferably in the sports industry
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow-up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with a service-focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre-tournament and operational tournament time)

Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • The Payroll and Benefits Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the payroll and benefits administration processes in a particular location to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant delivery of employee remuneration and associated benefits. This role requires a strong understanding of payroll regulations, benefits management, and employee satisfaction strategies while fostering alignment with global and local HR policies.

Responsibilities

  • You oversee the endtoend payroll process, ensuring accuracy and compliance with local labor laws, tax regulations, and SBM Offshore policies. You regularly monitor payroll outputs, promptly resolving any discrepancies or issues that arise. You ensure the timely submission of tax filings, social security contributions, and other statutory payments. Additionally, you collaborate with HR, Finance, and external vendors to maintain smooth and efficient payroll operations.
  • You manage various benefits programs, including health insurance, retirement plans, leave policies, and wellness initiatives. You review and suggest updates to benefits offerings to ensure they align with market trends and meet employee needs. You partner with benefits providers to maintain high service levels and cost efficiency, and you effectively communicate benefitsrelated information to employees.
  • You mentor and guide the Payroll and Benefits team, supporting their professional growth and development. You allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance, and address any skill gaps through training and support. You foster a collaborative work environment that aligns with SBM Offshore’s values and goals.
  • You ensure that payroll and benefits processes comply with local and global regulations, internal policies, and audits. You keep current on labor laws, tax regulations, and benefits trends to minimize risks. You support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and reports as needed.
  • You continuously identify opportunities to streamline payroll and benefits processes using technology and best practices. You develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and reports for HR and management review. Additionally, you contribute to HR strategic initiatives by providing valuable insights based on payroll and benefits data.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field. Payroll or benefitsspecific certifications are advantageous.

Experience

  • Experience in payroll and benefits management, preferably within the oil and gas or offshore industries.
  • Expertise in relevant social security reporting and regulations, ensuring accurate submissions and updates as required by law.
  • Handson experience with payroll systems tailored to local labor laws.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management skills.
  • Experience working with HRIS and payroll systems (e.g., SAP, Workday).
  • Strong knowledge of local labor laws, tax regulations, and benefits frameworks.
  • Analytical mindset with excellent problemsolving skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and payroll software.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with fluency in English and relevant local language.

Functional Competencies

Tools and data governance Diversity and inclusion Organization change and development Learning and development People engagement Payroll Labour law Change Management Personnel administration

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean Policy

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru

Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.

Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.

RESPONSIBILITIES

International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.
  • Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.
  • Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.
  • Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners).
  • Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.

Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries

  • In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.
  • Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.
  • As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.
  • Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.

Blue Climate Program

  • Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.
  • Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.
  • Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
  • Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.
  • Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.
  • Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.
  • Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.
  • Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.
  • Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.
  • Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions
  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.
  • Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.

title: Mecânico Diesel B
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de MECÂNICO B abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso:

Sua missão:

. Elabora desempeno de chassis, planos de manutenção; realiza manutenções de motores, sistemas e partes de veículos automotores.

. Substitui peças, repara e testa desempenho de componentes e sistemas de veículos.

Recepção para espaços de coworking médico

Sobre o cargo

Estamos buscando um(a) recepcionista excepcional para fazer parte do nosso time em uma clínica médica. O candidato ideal não é apenas alguém que sabe como receber bem as pessoas, mas também alguém com habilidades afiadas em vendas presenciais, supervisão de equipe e gerenciamento de crises. Este papel é crucial para criar uma experiência cativante para nossos pacientes, ao mesmo tempo em que assegura a excelência operacional da clínica.

Sobre a Habitat

A Habitat Consultórios é uma plataforma inovadora que conecta profissionais de saúde a espaços de atendimento, otimizando a utilização de consultórios e melhorando a experiência de profissionais e pacientes. A Habitat não é apenas um espaço de saúde; é uma experiência. Somos uma empresa dedicada a oferecer serviços de saúde de alta qualidade, onde a excelência no atendimento e a inovação se encontram. Aqui, cada detalhe é pensado para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Nossa cultura prioriza o relacionamento humano, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a adaptação às novidades do mercado. Se você é uma pessoa que busca impactar positivamente a vida dos outros e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e empenhada, você pertence à Habitat!

Cultura da Habitat

Valorizamos a proatividade, a excelência no atendimento e a capacidade de adaptar‑se e crescer em um ambiente dinâmico. Nossos colaboradores são incentivados a desenvolver suas habilidades e a buscar novas oportunidades de crescimento dentro da organização.

Atividades

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber pacientes e profissionais de saúde com um sorriso no rosto, garantindo que se sintam bem‑vindos e confortáveis.
  • Vendas Presenciais: Identificar oportunidades de upsell e cross‑sell de nossos serviços e produtos, mantendo um foco firme em atingir metas de vendas.
  • Gestão de Agenda: Organizar agendamentos e consultas utilizando sistemas de CRM, assegurando que a clínica funcione de forma eficiente.
  • Supervisão e Controle de Qualidade: Monitorar a equipe para garantir a entrega de um serviço de alta qualidade, resolvendo problemas e crises de maneira eficaz.
  • Ambientação de Profissionais de Saúde: Auxiliar na integração de novos profissionais à clínica, assegurando que estejam confortáveis e preparados para oferecer o melhor atendimento.
  • Gestão de Crises: Lidar com pacientes ou situações desafiadoras de forma calma e eficiente, mantendo a reputação da clínica intacta.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o atendimento presencial e via telefone, seguindo protocolos estabelecidos.
  • Coordenar e monitorar a equipe de limpeza.
  • Agendar, confirmar e desmarcar consultas através de múltiplos sistemas.
  • Alcançar metas de vendas e performance.
  • Fornecer feedbacks de melhoria para operação e infraestrutura da unidade.
  • Processar processos de autorização e validação de consultas e exames junto aos planos de saúde.

Our Brand / Sofitel

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Our Hotel / Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema

A landmark for Sofitel in the Americas, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema re-emerges as a revitalized beachfront icon where French elegance meets the vibrant Carioca lifestyle. SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrófica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Efetuar exames médicos, emitir diagnósticos, prescrever medicamentos, realizar outras formas de tratamento; tirar dúvidas e orientar pacientes em situações que requerem mais atenção.

Somos um time que cuidamos da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, no qual combinamos determinação e comprometimento para entregarmos produtos de qualidade. Entendemos que para obtermos os melhores resultados, precisamos dos melhores profissionais. Estamos à procura de talentos que sejam criativos, inovadores e ousados na busca por conhecimento, que tragam resultados sustentáveis ao Grupo Limppano.

Se você tem prazer em contribuir, gosta do que faz e é focado em resultados essa VAGA é para VOCÊ!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Reposição de Produtos: abastecer o ponto natural da categoria (gôndolas) e pontos extras negociados ou conquistados (ilhas, terminais, pontas de gôndolas, “orelhas”, entre outros) de acordo com as diretrizes da Limppano, evitando rupturas e respeitando o FIFO (primeiro que vence é o primeiro que sai).
  • Exposição e Organização: garantir que os produtos estejam organizados e alinhados com o planograma da empresa.
  • Montagem de Pontos Extras: instalar materiais promocionais (MPDV) e montar exposições sazonais, campanhas e ações promocionais.
  • Precificação: verificar e corrigir preços nos produtos e nas gôndolas conforme as informações da loja ou da empresa. Implementar as etiquetas de preços no PDV.
  • Controle de Estoque: acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.
  • Sugestão de Transferências: realizar sugestão de transferência de mercadoria do Centro de Distribuição (CD) para as lojas.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).
  • Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.

Condições de Trabalho:

  • Atuação externa com visitas a diferentes PDVs diariamente, seguindo a sistemática pré-determinada.
  • Trabalho físico leve a moderado (carga, movimentação e organização de produtos).
  • Eventual necessidade de deslocamento entre cidades da região.

title: Líder de Qualidade, Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Qualidade, Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (PD) para garantir a excelência e a conformidade dos produtos, atuando como barreira crítica de segurança da produção . Essa posição assegura que somente itens dentro de especificação avancem no processo, com rastreabilidade, evidências e registros completos , liderando a rotina do Controle de Qualidade Laboratorial e apoiando melhorias técnicas e frentes de PD.

Na prática, sua rotina costuma ser assim:

  • Inspeção de recebimento: garantir a execução de testes físico-químicos em matéria-prima e embalagens, com emissão de laudo de aprovação ou laudo de rejeição antes do descarregamento.
  • Liberação de linha e lote: coordenar coletas e análises durante o processo produtivo, assegurando a liberação documentada de cada lote produzido.
  • Bloqueio de não conformidade: identificar desvios em tempo real e executar bloqueio imediato da linha ou do lote, com registro fotográfico e sistêmico, acionando a liderança de operações.
  • Controle de retenção: organizar e catalogar o banco de amostras de retenção diária, garantindo 100% de cobertura por lote e fácil localização para rastreabilidade.
  • Gestão de equipamentos: assegurar rotina de calibração e limpeza dos equipamentos do laboratório, com checklist de aferição registrado no início de cada turno.
  • Gestão da rotina de Qualidade e PD: direcionar prioridades, garantir cumprimento de procedimentos, disciplina de registros/evidências e suporte técnico às necessidades do processo/produto.
  • Documentação e padrões: apoiar manutenção/atualização de POPs, formulários e registros do laboratório, garantindo conformidade e rastreabilidade.
  • Segurança e 5S: reforçar práticas de EPI, manuseio, descarte e organização do laboratório.

Requisitos

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Química ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Controle de Qualidade Laboratorial (rotina, liberação, rastreabilidade e registros).
  • Perfil de liderança para tomada de decisão e postura firme em bloqueios e tratativas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com tratativas de não conformidade e investigação de desvios (ex.: OOS/OOT).
  • Experiência com estruturação de padrões, checklists e rotina de evidências/registros.
  • Atuação com melhorias de processo e suporte técnico a iniciativas de desenvolvimento (PD).

description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Technical Process Support Engineer with a strong commercial mindset and solid process engineering experience within the oil and gas industry.

This role combines topside process engineering expertise with the ability to identify optimization opportunities, assess production assets, and translate technical diagnostics into value-generating business solutions for clients.

The professional will evaluate onshore and offshore production units, conduct technical audits, identify operational bottlenecks, and propose innovative, economically viable solutions focused on asset optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct technical and operational audits of oil and gas production assets.
  • Assess process performance, identify bottlenecks, and uncover optimization opportunities.

  • Translate technical findings into structured value propositions and improvement initiatives.
  • Develop optimization roadmaps focused on operational efficiency and economic return.
  • Support aftermarket services, brownfield projects, and topside modifications.
  • Interface directly with Operations, Engineering teams, suppliers, and clients to gain firsthand familiarity of customer needs plus product applications.
  • Provide technical support during commissioning, start‑up, ramp‑up, and operational phases (desirable).
  • Provides qualified technical sales support to sales team for marketing and sales activities, and to Operations for technical support as required.
  • Evaluate customer support issues as well as maintain top level positive perception by customers pertinent to organization support structure.
  • Prepare technical samples, designs along with presentations to provide supportive technical data as per customer needs.
  • Participate in sales support related conferences, trade shows, workshops plus meetings to update on current information plus developments in industry.

Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or related disciplines.

Experience

  • Proven experience as a Process Engineer within the oil and gas industry.
  • Experience working onboard offshore units and/or onshore production facilities.
  • Background in process audits, performance evaluation, and operational efficiency analysis.

Core Technical Knowledge

  • Oil, gas, and water separation systems.
  • Strong expertise in managing gas production operations and processes: topside, refining, downstrime, production platforms.
  • Gas treatment systems (H₂S/CO₂ removal via amine or membrane systems, dehydration, compression).
  • Produced water treatment systems.
  • Heat exchangers, pressure vessels, filtration systems, and utilities.
  • Familiarity with amine systems, membranes, fixed‑bed scavengers, and hybrid process configurations.
  • Experience in aftermarket services and brownfield environments.
  • Knowledge of oil and gas industry standards (API, ASME, NORSOK – desirable).
  • Strong interest in commercial activity, sales, and expanding business opportunities.
  • Process Simulation Software Expertise: Aspen HYSYS

Languages

  • Advanced English (mandatory).
  • Fluent Portuguese (mandatory).

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration : You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards : Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert" : When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership : Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.

  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).

  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).

Good to Have

  • Streaming : Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities / The Technology Stack

  • Backend : Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend : Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data : Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure : Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect‑Implementer : You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.

title: Incident Investigator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an Industrial Incident Investigator to join Loss Prevention Organization (LP)

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to help investigate industrial incidents (fires, major leaks, hydrocarbon explosions, etc.), identify proper root causes, and the actions necessary to prevent recurrence. This includes preparing draft and final incident reports, as well as providing long term support to address all recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Investigate industrial incidents, especially ones with high consequences and understand the hazards related to industrial facilities and their relevant controls.
  • Identify, preserve, and examine incident evidence using widely accepted forensic science principles.
  • Support investigation teams by ensuring proper investigation techniques are understood and used.
  • Conduct through investigations using appropriate investigative tools for the incident in question. Understand incident causation and impact of human factors.
  • Develop and/or thoroughly review all draft incident investigation reports and complete all stages of review.
  • Identify recommendations that should be shared globally for corporate wide implementation.
  • Develop lessons learned and safety alerts/bulletins to communicate actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Educate employees, contractors, and others, to ensure timely communication of lessons learned.
  • Develop and review corporate safety guidance on incident investigations.
  • You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering or Engineering Technology from an Accredited Institution,
  • You will have 10 years of experience investigating high consequence (major) industrial incidents, as well as a deep understanding of the various tools and techniques currently utilized to conduct such investigations.
  • You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
Department

Tournament and Venue Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision‑making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

Key Responsibilities

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow‑up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow‑up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre‑tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large‑scale international events, preferably in the sports industry.
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow‑up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution‑oriented mindset with a service‑focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre‑tournament and operational tournament time).
